fact: Article 4 of Law No 031/2022 of 21/11/2022 requires a public procuring entity to conduct the procurement process using the e-procurement system, unless the state organ in charge of procurement authorises otherwise.
title: Itegeko N° 031/2022 ryo ku wa 21/11/2022 rigenga amasoko ya Leta / Law governing public procurement
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
